name: Corn Palak
steps: Wash the spinach thoroughly and remove tough stems. Chop the tomato finely and have the sweet corn ready; if using frozen corn, separate any clumps.
Blanch spinach in boiling water for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Drain, cool with cold water, drain again and blend to a puree.
Steam or boil the corn separately until the kernels are tender when bitten, then drain. Follow the packet timing when using packaged corn.
Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat, add cumin and let it sizzle briefly. Add the tomato and cook for about 6 minutes until softened and pulpy, stirring to prevent sticking.
Stir in spinach puree, corn, the measured water and salt. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes until the flavours combine, stirring occasionally.
Check the consistency: the sauce should coat the corn without becoming dry. Add a little hot water if necessary and serve, avoiding prolonged cooking of the spinach.
tips: Avoid prolonged cooking after adding the spinach.
substitutions: For a cream finish, plain whisked curd may work: cool the pan and add gradually. Recheck dietary filters before substituting.
notes: Ingredient costs are estimates. Check local prices before shopping.
